svg.title: Global steel final energy | absolute levels

cc:Work.dc:title: Global steel final energy | absolute levels
cc:Work.dc:description: Global steel final-energy demand, shown in absolute source quantities with dashed matching reference trajectories. Rows show medium then high settings; columns show NDC then NDC+LTT. OPEN-PROM's corresponding NDC/NDC+LTT CSV supplies its reference; OMNIA uses the same climate's no-CE scenario. The two OMNIA curves change CE adoption area (EU or EU plus partners); every plotted quantity is global. OPEN-PROM medium/high scenario labels do not establish equivalent interventions or geographic coverage. OPEN-PROM uses the supplied World aggregate once; OMNIA sums its 28 model regions once. OPEN-PROM annual observations and OMNIA source years are retained from 2019 through 2050, without interpolation onto a common grid, smoothing, extrapolation or historical recalibration. OPEN-PROM selects Final Energy|Industry|Iron and Steel in Mtoe and multiplies by 0.041868 for EJ/yr. OMNIA sums exactly Electricity, Gases, Hydrogen, Liquids and Solids under the steel final-energy parent, in EJ/yr. Fuel children and energy-transformation inputs are not added. Final-energy units are aligned; full process boundaries remain source-defined. OMNIA missing additive activity follows the configured provisional zero treatment; OPEN-PROM requires complete reported World totals. Raw quantities, units, references, source scenarios and conversion factors accompany the figure data.
